UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile record in the users collection searchable by display name or unique Lumen user ID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

lumenId.description: Unique shareable Lumen User ID (e.g. LMN-XXXXXX).

displayNameLower.description: Lowercase display name for case-insensitive prefix search.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL (empty string if none).

searchable.description: Whether this user profile can be discovered by display name or user ID.

theme.description: Saved user theme preference (light or dark).

blur.description: Saved user frost blur level (4 to 48).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserDirectoryEntry.title: UserDirectoryEntry
UserDirectoryEntry.description: Public non-PII directory entry mapping a shareable Lumen User ID to a user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

lumenId.description: Unique shareable Lumen User ID (e.g. LMN-XXXXXX).

typingToLumenId.description: Target Lumen ID the user is currently typing a message to (empty string if idle).

typingFromName.description: Display name of the typing user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the directory entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the directory entry was last updated.

FriendRequest.title: FriendRequest
FriendRequest.description: A friend request sent using a Lumen User ID to initiate a conversation.

fromUid.description: UID of the user sending the friend request.

fromLumenId.description: Lumen User ID of the sender.

toUid.description: UID of the recipient user (or placeholder ID if pending directory match).

toLumenId.description: Target Lumen User ID of the recipient.

status.description: Current status of the friend request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A conversation document in Firestore linking two user IDs (or a group space).

ownerId.description: UID of the user who initiated this conversation.

participantIds.description: Bounded 2-element array of the two linked user IDs [userA, userB].

participantLumenIds.description: Bounded 2-element array of the two linked Lumen User IDs [LMN-A, LMN-B].

peerUserId.description: UID of the other user linked in this conversation.

peerLumenId.description: Unique Lumen User ID of the other participant.

name.description: Display name of the contact or group.

role.description: Subtitle or role description for the thread.

isGroup.description: Whether this conversation is a group space.

memberCount.description: Number of members in the conversation.

pinned.description: Whether the conversation is pinned in the sidebar.

pinnedMsgId.description: ID of the currently pinned message or empty string.

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of the most recent message.

lastMessageTime.description: Formatted time of the most recent message.

typingUserId.description: UID of the participant currently typing in this conversation (empty string when idle).

typingUserName.description: Display name of the participant currently typing in this conversation (empty string when idle).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was last updated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A message inside a conversation thread.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this message.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

me.description: Whether the message was sent by the current user.

dateGroup.description: Date grouping label such as Today.

edited.description: Whether the message text has been edited.

replyToId.description: ID of the message being replied to, or empty string.

forwardedFrom.description: Name of the source thread if forwarded, or empty string.

attachmentName.description: Attachment file name if kind is attachment.

attachmentSize.description: Formatted attachment size if kind is attachment.

attachmentUrl.description: Data URL or link for the attachment.

attachmentIsImage.description: Whether the attachment is an image.

audioUrl.description: Data URL for recorded voice notes.

pollQuestion.description: Poll question if kind is poll.

pollVotes.description: Selected poll option labels voted by the user (up to 4 strings).

reactions.description: Emoji strings reacted to this message (up to 13 strings).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents searchable by display name or unique Lumen User ID.

/userDirectory/{lumenId}.description: Public non-PII user ID directory for looking up a user by their Lumen ID.

/friendRequests/{requestId}.description: Friend requests sent between users by Lumen ID to start conversations.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: User conversations linking two user IDs (or group spaces).

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Messages belonging to a specific conversation.
